lines.lyric_translation: Time runs

lines.lyric: Machi nae kkumcheoreom day and night
lines.lyric_hangul: 마치 내 꿈처럼 Day and night
lines.lyric_translation: Like my dreams, day and night
I’m carrying them on my neck
Throwing my memories outside
This is like a drama without a script
It’s an ending you’ve never thought of
The dust that covered my heart before
Now presses down on my dreams
Throwback, swallows up the dark night

lines.lyric: Ijeneun naega gajyeoganeun taeyange bulgeun bichi
lines.lyric_hangul: 이제는 내가 가져가는 태양의 붉은 빛이
lines.lyric_translation: Now I have the bright light of the sun that I took
Next, in the cold dawn, I see the lonely moon

lines.lyric: Weroi tteun dal bomyeo eolgureul dwideopeo shimchwi
lines.lyric_hangul: 외로이 뜬 달 보며 얼굴을 뒤덮어 심취
lines.lyric_translation: It covers my face, intoxicating me
Like it’s coloring me black
My head is burning
Question marks filling me up, blaming myself

lines.lyric: Ijeneun boiji anneun dabeul wihaeseo dallyeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 이제는 보이지 않는 답을 위해서 달려
lines.lyric_translation: Now I’m running for an answer I can’t even see

lines.lyric: Running on my mind hajiman sogeun deo dabdabhae
lines.lyric_hangul: Running on my mind 하지만 속은 더 답답해
lines.lyric_translation: Running on my mind but I’m feeling even more frustrated
This is a fight for my tomorrow

lines.lyric: Jigeum nae sangtae machi eojeye miraereul bon deuthae yeah
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 내 상태 마치 어제의 미래를 본 듯해 Yeah
lines.lyric_translation: Right now, I feel like I’ve seen the future from yesterday

lines.lyric: Misoreul sshik namege bilbilgeorimyeo hansumeul pik
lines.lyric_hangul: 미소를 씩 남에게 빌빌거리며 한숨을 픽
lines.lyric_translation: I’m putting on a smile, letting out a sigh

lines.lyric: Jigeumeun oneure naneun nal boneun geotcheoreom
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금은 오늘의 나는 날 보는 것처럼
lines.lyric_translation: Feels like I’m taking a look at myself
A momentary silence
The slower I walk, the more the wind pushes me
Turn up with this wandering

lines.lyric: Jamshi dongan naege jamdeun shiganeul jweo
lines.lyric_hangul: 잠시 동안 내게 잠든 시간을 줘
lines.lyric_translation: Give me some time to sleep

lines.lyric: Nae salme deohae odab gateun jeongdabeul naege show
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 삶에 더해 오답 같은 정답을 내게 Show
lines.lyric_translation: Show me an answer that’s like the wrong answer

lines.lyric: Jigeum naege boineun geot da geojitmariya igeon
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 내게 보이는 것 다 거짓말이야 이건
lines.lyric_translation: What I see right now is all a lie
I go around but I’m stuck in the same time

lines.lyric: Shipeoreon haneul arae bulkge taneun uri norae
lines.lyric_hangul: 시퍼런 하늘 아래 붉게 타는 우리 노래 붉게 타는 우리 노래
lines.lyric_translation: Under the blue sky, our song burns red

lines.lyric: Bulkge taneun uri norae apeul makneun geochin moraebaram
lines.lyric_translation: Our song burns red and the sandy wind tries to stop it
Like a whale hunting for food

lines.lyric: Geureotago meogil jul suneun eopseo naneun weollae geurae
lines.lyric_hangul: 그렇다고 먹일 줄 수는 없어 나는 원래 그래
lines.lyric_translation: But I can’t just get eaten, that’s how I am
When stones come flying from here and there

lines.lyric: Naraomyeon kallo chingching da beeobeorin daeum
lines.lyric_hangul: 날아오면 칼로 칭칭 다 베어버린 다음
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll cut them up with a sword
Turning them into pieces, making the pieces into a mountain
And giving it all back
It’s boiling up, the anger I held

lines.lyric: Kkeureo ollyeo geogi hwae gachin nal
lines.lyric_translation: I’m lifting myself up from being trapped in anger
I wish that anger would bloom into a flower
Instead of a sea of fire, I want to be in a bed of flowers
Devils chattering above the highway

lines.lyric: Bokjabhame gonggi junge tteodoneun nae nwe
lines.lyric_hangul: 복잡함의 공기 중에 떠도는 내 뇌

lines.lyric_hangul: 그 뇌를 낚아챈 건 높이 나는 새네
lines.lyric_translation: What saved my brain are the birds that fly high

lines.lyric_hangul: 그 새의 등 뒤에 타 나는 비행해
lines.lyric_translation: I’m riding on the back of those birds, flying
Imma look back
